title: Perturbation Probing: A Two-Pass-per-Prompt Diagnostic for FFN Behavioral Circuits in Aligned LLMs
reasoning: The paper focuses on mechanistic interpretability and circuit discovery within LLMs. While it uses safety refusal benchmarks (which involve ethical alignment) to validate its findings, the core focus is on the diagnostic method and neural circuitry rather than evaluating or benchmarking religious, moral, or ethical frameworks themselves.
